info.title: BayRelayAgentTools
info.description: Single entrypoint for all BayRelay control-plane tools. Pass operation name and parameters; never invent ids or secrets.

post.description: Invoke exactly one backend operation by name. Use validateTransferRequest and checkPolicyCompliance before submitTransferRequest. For live state use getTransferStatus. Operations: validateTransferRequest, classifyTransferType, buildExecutionPlan, checkPolicyCompliance, estimateTransferMethod, submitTransferRequest, startTransferExecution, retryTransferExecution, cancelTransferExecution, getTransferStatus, listRecentFailures, summarizeFailure, generateRunbookAdvice, registerPartner, registerEndpoint, disableEndpoint, rotateCredentialReference.

operation.description: Tool name matching the API, e.g. validateTransferRequest or submitTransferRequest.

parameters.description: Key-value arguments for that tool (partner_id, transfer_type, request_id, etc.).

200.description: Tool result as JSON object from the Lambda implementation.

result.description: Payload returned by the selected tool.
